latestHistory.note: 2026-09-25 verified charter-template progress, source/evidence HEAD 1d256b09b5a7fe273d2e340b6c4014b722f9d49d. Players can keep up to 24 named charter templates in a personal browser/origin-local library, each holding an existing charter focus and coin ceiling. Selecting a template issues no orders; Recall fills the form and Apply charters remains a separate explicit action. Saving, updating or deleting templates leaves active charters unchanged. Templates survive browser reload and campaign changes but are excluded from campaign exports; applied charters remain canonical saved and replayed state. Strict bounded storage validation and transactional writes preserve existing rows on failure, and visible storage errors leave direct charter controls usable. Final publication verification passes 1,904 headless tests across 237 files, 16 affected Chromium journeys, 30 local production Pages journeys and 30 live Pages journeys. These are separate suite scopes, not additive test totals. Rules/save remain 31, content remains 015468d1; this browser preference slice changes no rules, AI or campaign prices and requires no new pacing run. Evidence: ~/Work/Theandril/docs/development/2026-09-25-charter-templates/. ACT-32 and M3 remain in progress. Durable named groups, theaters/patrol/escorts, army-order templates, production sequences, broader governor decisions and combined mature-realm acceptance remain open. All 15 release gates remain open.

M3.title: Empire delegation and coordinated orders
M3.detail: Standing charters, muster points, army postings and cause-grouped alerts exist. Batches assign or clear existing postings for up to 128 land armies ashore, or grant/revoke existing charters for up to 128 owned hearths, with ordinary canonical validation and individual overrides. The 25 September slice adds a reusable charter-policy library: Players can keep up to 24 named charter templates in a personal browser/origin-local library, each holding an existing charter focus and coin ceiling. Selecting a template issues no orders; Recall fills the form and Apply charters remains a separate explicit action. Saving, updating or deleting templates leaves active charters unchanged. Templates survive browser reload and campaign changes but are excluded from campaign exports; applied charters remain canonical saved and replayed state. Strict bounded storage validation and transactional writes preserve existing rows on failure, and visible storage errors leave direct charter controls usable. Final publication verification passes 1,904 headless tests across 237 files, 16 affected Chromium journeys, 30 local production Pages journeys and 30 live Pages journeys. These are separate suite scopes, not additive test totals. Rules/save 31 and content 015468d1 are unchanged. Durable named groups, theaters/patrol/escorts, army-order templates, production sequences, broader governor decisions and combined mature-realm acceptance remain open.
